title: AI Voice Interaction Upgraded: OpenAI Desktop Version of ChatGPT Launches New Features Supporting Voice Control to Execute Multi-Step Tasks
excerpt: Artificial intelligence assistants have made a new breakthrough in desktop interaction experiences. On Thursday local time, OpenAI announced an important update
content_html:
Artificial intelligence assistants have made a new breakthrough in desktop interaction experiences. On Thursday local time, OpenAI announced an important update to its ChatGPT desktop application, officially launching support for ChatGPT Voice. With this new feature, users can now directly converse with ChatGPT through voice and control the AI agent to independently perform various complex tasks on their computers.

According to the information, this new feature is based on the newly launched ChatGPT-Live series of speech models by OpenAI earlier this month. ChatGPT Voice currently fully supports ChatGPT Work and Codex, and also has strong computer operation capabilities, helping users smoothly access various websites and applications. Especially on macOS systems, combined with the Appshots feature, users can even authorize the AI to access all content on the screen and alternative text (alt-text).

Compared to the previous mobile voice functions that mainly focused on providing a smooth conversation experience and optimizing interruption handling, this desktop update has achieved a qualitative leap in execution capability. Users can issue compound commands with simple voice commands and interactively respond when ChatGPT needs to supplement information or conduct a second confirmation. In the official demonstration, a developer successfully guided the AI to create a new code thread, submit a Pull Request, and quickly locate the root cause of a Bug with just one voice command. Additionally, OpenAI also revealed that users can use the remote access function of the iOS app to call ChatGPT Voice in Codex as well.

At the same time, industry competitors are also investing heavily in the voice interaction sector. Anthropic has also introduced a new voice mode for its Claude, which can call its Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models to efficiently handle various daily work tasks in mainstream office applications such as Gmail, Calendar, Slack, Notion, and Canva.

content_html_zh:
人工智能助手在桌面交互体验上取得了新的突破。 当地时间周四，OpenAI 宣布对其 ChatGPT 桌面应用程序进行重要更新，正式推出对 ChatGPT Voice 的支持。 借助这一新功能，用户现在可以直接通过语音与ChatGPT对话，并控制AI代理在计算机上独立执行各种复杂的任务。

资料显示，这一新功能基于OpenAI本月初新推出的ChatGPT-Live系列语音模型。 ChatGPT Voice 目前全面支持 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex，同时还具备强大的计算机操作能力，帮助用户顺利访问各种网站和应用程序。 特别是在macOS系统上，结合Appshots功能，用户甚至可以授权AI访问屏幕上的所有内容和替代文本（alt-text）。

相比之前主要注重提供流畅的通话体验和优化中断处理的移动语音功能，本次桌面版更新在执行能力上实现了质的飞跃。 用户可以通过简单的语音命令发出复合命令，并在ChatGPT需要补充信息或进行二次确认时进行交互响应。 在官方演示中，开发者仅用一个语音命令，就成功引导AI创建新的代码线程、提交Pull Request，并快速定位Bug的根源。 此外，OpenAI还透露，用户还可以使用iOS应用程序的远程访问功能来调用Codex中的ChatGPT Voice。

与此同时，行业竞争对手也在语音交互领域大力投入。 Anthropic还为其Claude推出了全新的语音模式，可以调用其Opus、Sonnet和Haiku模型，高效处理Gmail、Calendar、Slack、Notion、Canva等主流办公应用中的各种日常工作任务。
